checks.name: Real mouse capture requests raw input
Movement with stationary mouse does not turn camera
Shooting without moving does not drift camera
Intentional fast-turn deltas are preserved (synthetic packet)
Touch compatibility mouse events are ignored
Invalid movement cannot corrupt camera angles
Shoulder crossing a wall corner does not snap camera metres
Unsupported raw input falls back to ordinary real capture
Denied capture still permits intentional drag look
Missing mouse release cannot leave drag look or fire latched
